recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century modern album cover featuring a high-contrast male portrait against a draped fabric background, topped by a solid color header containing ultra-condensed typography bisected by a graphic lightning bolt.
coreVisualRelationships: Solid header bar vs. textured photographic lower section
Verticality of the background drapes mirroring the condensed letterforms
Graphic lightning bolt acting as a visual separator for the main title
coreInvariants: Solid blue header occupying the top 20-25% of the frame
A central graphic icon (lightning bolt) breaking the header text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale head-and-shoulders portrait centered in the lower three-quarters of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid blue header bar provides a heavy horizontal anchor at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bright white text in the header, follows the lightning bolt down to the subject's face, then follows the vertical lines of the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The solid header acts as a controlled negative space for the display type.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Medium cerulean blue in the header and background drapes.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale yellow or cream for the lightning bolt graphic.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues; high value contrast between white text and blue background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'S' has very shallow curves to maintain the narrow width
The 'G' has a high, simple crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for the main title, paired with a small, wide sans-serif for metadata in the corner.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and narrow profile
Captures the extreme verticality and 1960s feel
Provides the clean, modern sans-serif structure

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A portrait of a man with 1960s styled hair against a backdrop of vertical teal and blue fabric drapes. The top 20% of the image should be a solid, flat cerulean blue rectangle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, white, ultra-condensed sans-serif title in uppercase across the blue header. Place a pale yellow jagged lightning bolt graphic in the center of the header, splitting the text into two halves.

verificationChecks: Is the header a solid, flat color block?
Is the text extremely narrow and tall?
Does the lightning bolt visually divide the text?
Is the portrait lighting soft but directional?

mustRedesign: Record label logo in the top right corner
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the lightning bolt does not overlap the subject's head.
Check that the text is perfectly centered vertically within the blue bar.
Verify the background drapes have a soft, out-of-focus quality.
Confirm the typography is exclusively uppercase.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid color header + Ultra-condensed white display type + Central graphic icon + Portrait against vertical textures.
